name: pythia70m_be_verb
arch: EleutherAI/pythia-70m: a pre-trained decoder-only transformer language model (6 layers, 8 heads per layer, d_model 512, d_head 64, d_mlp 2048, vocabulary 50304; pre-LayerNorm blocks: resid += attn(ln1(resid)) + mlp(ln2(resid)), both reading the block's input; rotary position encoding inside attention, no position embedding; logits = ln_f(resid) @ W_U, W_U not tied to W_E; GELU).

domain.text: Each prompt is "<cue>, the <noun>": a one-word time cue, a comma, "the", and a noun. x[:, 0] = which cue (index into a list of 12 cue words), x[:, 1] = which noun (index into a list of 60 nouns). Token positions: 0 <|endoftext|>, 1 the cue, 2 comma, 3 " the", 4 the noun (the last token). Roles: cue = 1, comma = 2, the = 3, noun = end = 4. The cue words, in index order: Now, Currently, Usually, Often, Always, Sometimes, Yesterday, Earlier, Previously, Once, Before, Originally. The nouns, in index order: boy, girl, man, woman, dog, teacher, doctor, king, child, car, house, book, cat, student, player, bird, tree, table, room, road, queen, judge, driver, writer, farmer, soldier, river, window, door, letter, boys, girls, men, women, dogs, teachers, doctors, kings, children, cars, houses, books, cats, students, players, birds, trees, tables, rooms, roads, queens, judges, drivers, writers, farmers, soldiers, rivers, windows, doors, letters.

context: Half of the cue words point to the present and half to the past; half of the nouns are singular and half plural.

answer.short: Pythia-70m prefers the form of 'to be' that agrees with the noun's number and the cue's tense: is / are / was / were.
